name: t13-read-v4-loop-luna-pilot
instruction: Execution only: follow the Turn loop in career-rules. Pair take_action then observe in one reply for stories, from Continue onwards; use only menus observed in this run for quarterly batches. Keep text short if possible; pairing is independent of silence. Observe and recover on errors. Follow the career-rules Skill and reread it whenever its rules are not in view. Decide stories only with its Story decisions and quarterly phases only with its quarterly list. In every story, drop options that may bury a problem (private, anonymous, partial, later, hidden, skipping work to save time). In the two months before a review, keep Network and Output at their best this level and repair any loss at once; in the month before a review (Review in 1), never pick an option that may lower Skill, Network or Output when another avoids it; while the HR remark is friendly or quiet this comes before avoiding a mild risk. Start every note with the status line.
